def: to give (or take) a seat in company with

occurrences.text: And when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the hall, and were set down together, Peter sat down among them.
And hath raised us up together, and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus:

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
